text: Probe targets are fixed to force, distance, velocity, energy and accel_step. Several open questions (q-20261011-225319-fc03 on a^3, q-20261011-225358-0609 on a^2/r, q-20261011-231118-3513 on (v*dt)^2/a, q-20261011-224242-6402 on the fitter run against the true target) can't be tested through the config. Should these targets and a fitter-on-ground-truth check be added to the probe suite?
